summary: Crate Entertainment's dark fantasy action RPG, expanded on PC for years and later released on Xbox as a bundled Definitive Edition.

entries.title: Grim Dawn
entries.definitive_edition: Grim Dawn Definitive Edition on PC is the current complete package; Fangs of Asterkarn is announced but not yet released as of June 22, 2026.

emulation.notes: No emulation needed; use native PC for capture and the most flexible settings.

primary.version: Grim Dawn Definitive Edition on PC with Ashes of Malmouth, Forgotten Gods, and Crucible; revisit after Fangs of Asterkarn ships
primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity native version, broad storefront availability, PC settings, and the complete currently released expansion set; the Xbox One Definitive Edition bundles the same older expansions but is a console port.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Definitive Edition through Steam, GOG, or another PC storefront for the full current released package, then add Fangs of Asterkarn after its July 23, 2026 launch if doing a post-expansion definitive run.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Xbox One Definitive Edition is a bundled port, not a remaster with exclusive content. Future completeness changes when Fangs of Asterkarn releases.
